# Data dictionary (generated by `python -m harvest.export_powerbi`)

## dim_date.csv

1,096 rows · primary key: `date_key`

| Column | Power BI type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `date_key` | Whole number | Surrogate key, YYYYMMDD integer |
| `date` | Date | Calendar date (ISO) |
| `year` | Whole number | Calendar year |
| `quarter` | Text | Calendar quarter label, e.g. Q1 |
| `quarter_number` | Whole number | Calendar quarter 1-4 |
| `month_number` | Whole number | Month 1-12 (sort column for month_name) |
| `month_name` | Text | Month name, e.g. January |
| `month_short` | Text | Month abbreviation, e.g. Jan |
| `year_month` | Text | YYYY-MM label |
| `month_start_date` | Date | First day of the month (ISO) |
| `iso_year` | Whole number | ISO 8601 week-numbering year |
| `iso_week` | Whole number | ISO 8601 week number |
| `week_start_date` | Date | Monday of the week (ISO); boxes are delivered weekly |
| `day_of_month` | Whole number | Day 1-31 |
| `day_of_week_number` | Whole number | 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday |
| `day_name` | Text | Day name, e.g. Monday |
| `is_weekend` | Whole number | 1 if Saturday or Sunday |
| `season` | Text | UK meteorological season (Winter = Dec-Feb) |
| `uk_fiscal_year` | Text | UK financial year starting 1 April, e.g. FY2024/25 |

## dim_customer.csv

12,000 rows · primary key: `customer_id`

| Column | Power BI type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | Whole number | Customer key |
| `signup_date` | Date | Sign-up date (ISO) |
| `signup_date_key` | Whole number | Sign-up date as YYYYMMDD (inactive relationship to dim_date) |
| `region` | Text | UK region |
| `channel_id` | Whole number | Acquisition channel key |
| `signup_plan_id` | Whole number | Plan chosen at sign-up |
| `age_band` | Text | Self-reported age band |
| `first_box_date` | Date | Date of first delivered box (blank if none) |
| `cohort_month` | Date | First day of the month of the first delivered box (retention cohort) |
| `cancel_date` | Date | Cancellation date (blank if still subscribed) |
| `has_cancelled` | Whole number | 1 if the customer has cancelled |
| `rfm_segment` | Text | RFM segment, same rules as sql/07_rfm_segmentation.sql |

## fact_orders.csv

124,409 rows · primary key: `order_id`

| Column | Power BI type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | Whole number | Box key (unique) |
| `customer_id` | Whole number | Customer key |
| `delivery_date` | Date | Delivery date (ISO) |
| `date_key` | Whole number | Delivery date as YYYYMMDD |
| `plan_id` | Whole number | Plan key |
| `status` | Text | delivered or refunded |
| `is_delivered` | Whole number | 1 if delivered (revenue counts), 0 if refunded |
| `revenue_gbp` | Fixed decimal (currency) | Amount charged after discount (GBP) |
| `discount_gbp` | Fixed decimal (currency) | Discount given (GBP) |
| `ingredient_cost_gbp` | Fixed decimal (currency) | Ingredient cost of the box (GBP) |
| `fulfilment_cost_gbp` | Fixed decimal (currency) | Packaging and delivery cost, fixed at 6.50 (GBP) |
| `gross_margin_gbp` | Fixed decimal (currency) | revenue - ingredients - fulfilment (GBP) |
| `months_since_first_box` | Whole number | Calendar months since the customer's first delivered box (0 = cohort month; -1 for a few refunded boxes before it) |

## fact_web_sessions.csv

26,000 rows · primary key: `session_id`

| Column | Power BI type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | Whole number | Web session key |
| `visitor_id` | Whole number | Pseudonymous visitor ID |
| `session_start` | Date/Time | Timestamp of the first event (ISO, local time) |
| `date_key` | Whole number | Session start date as YYYYMMDD |
| `device` | Text | mobile, desktop or tablet |
| `ab_variant` | Text | Checkout A/B test arm (A = old, B = one-page checkout) |
| `reached_landing` | Whole number | 1 if the session reached the landing page |
| `reached_menu` | Whole number | 1 if it reached the menu |
| `reached_plan_select` | Whole number | 1 if it reached plan selection |
| `reached_checkout` | Whole number | 1 if it reached checkout |
| `purchased` | Whole number | 1 if it purchased |
